till late at night phrase

also far into the night, until late at night, stay up late

classical

Traupman 88, 394
Cic. Sen. 46: ad multam noctem

ad multam noctem

far into the night, till late at night

Examples

  • quod ad multam noctem quam maximē possumus variō sermōne prōdūcimus

    which we draw out far into the night, as long as we can, with all kinds of talkCic. Sen. 46

  • Ad multam noctem etiam ad impedīmenta pugnātum est.

    At the baggage too the fighting went on far into the night.Caes. BG 1.26.3

See also late at night.

SourcesJohn C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, supplied PDF (printed page numbers): p. 88.
